claim: Test whether two target-blind cross-feature components repair NGC2955 after the sealed RAR-plus-single-feature grammar failed. This is an exploration-set grammar-development reproduction, not an independent discovery or novelty test.

candidate_shell.base: the frozen G0 empirical RAR with its frozen universal g_dagger
candidate_shell.feature_normalization: each allowed baryonic feature is deterministically mapped to [-1,1] using its within-galaxy baryonic minimum and maximum; V_obs is never read
candidate_shell.fit: two-column weighted least squares on training radii only

single_feature_families.fourier_frequencies: 24 geometric values in [1/4,16], both sin(pi*k*z) and cos(pi*k*z)
single_feature_families.hinges: 17 centers in [-1,1], powers {1/2,1,2,3}, both orientations, omitting the two identically-zero endpoint orientations

component_grammar.interaction_family: T_i(z_feature_a)*T_j(z_feature_b) for every unordered feature pair and i,j in {1,...,6}

admission.scope: every frozen contiguous radial fold and aggregate out-of-fold predictions

diagnostic_disclosure.sealed_run_is: an exhaustive reproduction and accounting test, not independent confirmation

decision.pass: the sealed v1 138-galaxy coverage plus at least one CPU-FP64-admitted NGC2955 interaction formula covers all 139 exploration galaxies after all 6,081,328 unique pairs are tested
decision.block: NGC2955 remains uncovered, the grammar under-runs, predecessor validation fails, or confirmation access occurs
decision.after_pass: authorize G2 equivalence collapse while keeping confirmation data unopened
